description: The file 'misc.h' is a C header file that declares functions and macros for managing a PCIe endpoint, including clock, GPIO, and interrupt operations in a Linux driver context for a hardware component. It provides interface declarations for external implementation.

methods.name: dc_ep_clkod_disable
methods.description: Disables the clock or resets clock-related hardware for the PCIe endpoint.

methods.name: dc_ep_icu_init
methods.description: Initializes the interrupt configuration unit for the PCIe endpoint.

methods.name: dc_ep_icu_disable
methods.description: Disables interrupt configuration for the PCIe endpoint.

methods.name: dc_ep_assert_device
methods.description: Asserts (activates) the device signals based on specified bits.

methods.name: dc_ep_deassert_device
methods.description: Deasserts (deactivates) the device signals based on specified bits.

methods.name: dc_ep_reset_device
methods.description: Resets the device by applying reset bits; returns status.

methods.name: dc_ep_clk_on
methods.description: Turns on the clock signal for the device.

methods.name: dc_ep_clk_off
methods.description: Turns off the clock signal for the device.

methods.name: dc_ep_clk_set
methods.description: Sets clock frequencies for the device's sysclk and ppeclk.

methods.name: dc_ep_clk_get
methods.description: Retrieves current clock settings for sysclk and ppeclk.

methods.name: dc_ep_gpio_dir
methods.description: Configures GPIO pin direction (input or output).

methods.name: dc_ep_gpio_set
methods.description: Sets GPIO pin output value.

methods.name: dc_ep_gpio_get
methods.description: Reads GPIO pin input value.

methods.name: dc_ep_pinmux_set
methods.description: Configures pin multiplexing functions for GPIO.

methods.name: dc_ep_pinmux_get
methods.description: Retrieves current pin mux configuration.

methods.name: dc_ep_gpio_pupd_set
methods.description: Sets pull-up/pull-down resistors on GPIO.

methods.name: dc_ep_gpio_od_set
methods.description: Configures open-drain mode for a GPIO.

methods.name: dc_ep_gpio_src_set
methods.description: Sets GPIO source.

methods.name: dc_ep_gpio_dcc_set
methods.description: Configures GPIO DCC (possibly a dedicated control).

methods.name: dc_ep_icu_dis_intr
methods.description: Disables specific interrupts.

methods.name: dc_ep_icu_en_intr
methods.description: Enables specific interrupts.
